item.title: Tehran says Strait of Hormuz "under Iran's control" after Trump threat
item.description: Tehran has asserted that the Strait of Hormuz is "under Iran's control and management" after President Trump said the U.S. might "keep it."

item.title: Democrats pressure Trump administration to rescue 10 other Americans detained in Russia
item.description: Democratic lawmakers are urging the State Department to take measures to secure the release of 10 other Americans detained in Russia following Robert Gilman's release. Kieran L. Ramsey, the chief investigative officer at Global Reach, an organization that assisted with Gilman's release, joins CBS News with more.

item.title: Total solar eclipse dipped parts of Europe into complete darkness. Here's what they saw.
item.description: A total solar eclipse brought darkness to parts of Europe, the only time the phenomenon will be visible to humans in 2026. CBS News' Rob Marciano has more on the stunning moments.

item.title: Single winning ticket sold for $1.04 billion Powerball jackpot
item.description: A single ticket sold in Illinois won the biggest Powerball jackpot of the year, $1.04 billion, in Wednesday night's drawing, the game says.

item.title: Views of the total solar eclipse from parts of Europe
item.description: A total solar eclipse was visible in parts of Europe for the first time since 1912. Rob Marciano reports.

item.title: Single Powerball ticket sold in Illinois wins $1.04 billion
item.description: Someone in Illinois purchased the winning $1.04-billion Powerball ticket. Dan Geltrude, a certified public accountant, joins CBS News with tips for the lucky winner.

item.title: Single ticket sold in Illinois wins $1 billion Powerball jackpot
item.description: Only one Powerball ticket, sold in western Illinois, matched all six numbers from Wednesday's $1 billion drawing. Tom Hanson reports.

item.title: Former Disney CEO Bob Iger, venture capitalist Josh Kushner buy LA Lakers
item.description: Former Disney CEO Bob Iger and investor Josh Kushner, brother of President Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner, have agreed to buy the Los Angeles Lakers for a record reported $12.5 billion. Kelly O'Grady reports.

item.title: Surrogate mother gives birth to baby with severe heart condition despite biological parents' wishes
item.description: A surrogate gave birth to a baby in Texas with a severe health condition despite the biological parents' wish to end the pregnancy. CBS News' Jason Allen reports.

item.title: 60 cats rescued from abandoned boat anchored off Washington state
item.description: Police in Tacoma, Washington, say they have rescued 60 cats and kittens from an abandoned sailboat that was found anchored off a city beach last week.

item.title: Luigi Mangione may discuss a plea deal with federal prosecutors, sources say
item.description: Luigi Mangione is expected in federal court for a hearing on Friday. This comes as sources tell CBS News that his defense team may discuss a potential plea deal with prosecutors. CBS News' Caroline Polisi has more.

item.title: Possible plea deal to be discussed in Luigi Mangione case, sources say
item.description: Federal prosecutors and defense attorneys in the Luigi Mangione case have requested a special hearing on Friday. Sources involved in the federal case say both sides will likely discuss a possible plea deal for the 28-year-old who is accused of killing UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson. CBS News legal contributor Caroline Polisi breaks down the case.

item.title: Trump's secret plane switch took place within a day of credible missile threat
item.description: President Trump secretly moved from Air Force One to another plane within a day of U.S. and Turkish intelligence picking up on an Iranian plot to fire a missile at the jet, CBS News has learned.

item.title: 2 soldiers killed in Apache helicopter crash in Texas
item.description: The U.S. Army is investigating after an Apache helicopter crashed Wednesday in central Texas, killing both crew members on board and sparking a wildfire. Army officials say the helicopter was on a training flight when it crashed. Charlie D'Agata reports.

item.title: First responders use boats to rescue people from flooded homes, cars in Midwest
item.description: Extreme flooding in parts of Indiana reached car roofs and sent water rushing into homes, leading to first responders using boats to rescue people who were trapped. Meg Oliver reports on the damage.

item.title: Official describes "violent" Army Apache helicopter crash in Texas
item.description: The U.S. Army is investigating an Apache helicopter crash in Texas that killed two soldiers. CBS News' Charlie D'Agata reports.

item.title: Roads destroyed and homes flood in Midwest after severe flooding
item.description: Severe flooding ravaged parts of Indiana, ruining people's homes and destroying roads. CBS News' Meg Oliver reports.

item.title: DHS defends agent who pointed gun at woman but hasn't provided proof on claims against her
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security is reacting after a video emerged of a federal agent pointing a gun at a Virginia woman while she was inside her car. CBS News' Michael George reports.

item.title: Trump's covert swap from Air Force One happened a day after Iran's deadly threat
item.description: President Trump switched from Air Force One before departing from Turkey a day after the Iranian missile threat. CBS News' Aaron Navarro reports.

item.title: Search for survivors of Colombia earthquake enters "final phase"
item.description: Rescuers in Colombia were making last-ditch efforts to locate earthquake survivors early Thursday as the critical 72-hour window for rescue operations neared its end.

item.title: $5,255 fine issued after foghorn wakes up sleeping polar bear
item.description: Under local regulations, "it is forbidden to needlessly disturb, attract or pursue a polar bear," which was declared a protected species in 1972.

item.title: Democratic senators demand answers about conditions aboard USS Abraham Lincoln
item.description: Senate Democrats are demanding answers about conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln during the aircraft carrier's record-setting deployment.

item.title: The Helicopter Parents Have Entered the Workplace | Money Moves with Jill Schlesinger
item.description: Jill and Mark discuss the rise of "helicopter parenting" in the workplace— why mom and dad need to back off. Then, they help Marie, a caller with a newborn and a toddler, figure out how to start saving for college. They dig into whether Trump Accounts or 529s make more sense, and how to keep things fair between her children. Plus: Are young people really spending too much money on McDonald's?

item.title: Police seize 1,000 pounds of cocaine with stickers of soccer star
item.description: Police released a video showing the packages spilling out from the truck's false bottom, with the stickers of Norway's soccer star Erling Haaland.

item.title: Trump says U.S. has "total control" over Strait of Hormuz
item.description: President Trump said Wednesday that the U.S. has "total control" over the Strait of Hormuz, writing on social media: "I THINK WE WILL KEEP IT."

item.title: Lindsay Clancy sobs loudly, says "I can't do it" amid gruesome trial testimony
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's murder trial was paused multiple times Wednesday afternoon as she sobbed loudly and said "I can't do it" during testimony.

item.title: My husband was kicked out of hospice. Here's what I learned.
item.description: Some seriously ill patients improve on hospice. About 1 in 16 patients enrolled in hospice care lose eligibility as a result. Here's how to get appropriate care.

item.title: Surrogate gives birth to baby at center of multistate legal battle
item.description: Surrogate McKenna West declined to get an abortion requested by the intended parents after the baby she was carrying was diagnosed with a severe but treatable heart defect.

item.title: 2 killed as Apache helicopter from Fort Hood crashes in Salado, Texas
item.description: Two soldiers aboard an AH-64 Apache attack helicopter based out of Fort Hood were killed in a crash on Wednesday, according to local authorities and the Army.

item.title: Stunning photos show total solar eclipse over Europe
item.description: The only total solar eclipse of 2026 crossed the Northern Hemisphere Wednesday, with a path of totality across parts of Greenland, Iceland and northern Spain. See photos and video from the best viewing locations.
